description: Use this when the user wants to find, search, or browse study documents, lecture notes, summaries, or course materials on Studocu. Pass topic/keywords as `query` only — never put course name, course id, or institution name in `query`. `institution` is a display name only (this tool has no institution_id). Prefer numeric `course_id` from search-courses when you have it: it pins the course and overrules `course`. If both `course_id` and `institution` are sent, `course_id` wins; result institution is that course's university, not the name you passed. Otherwise pass `course` as name or code, never as a numeric id. `course` is optional extra if you already have `course_id`. Omit unknown filters. Returns matching documents with titles, course and institution info, ratings, and a link to view each on Studocu.

course.description: Course name or code only, e.g. "Economics" or "ECON101". Use when you do not have `course_id`. Never put a numeric id here. Optional extra if you also have `course_id`. Omit entirely if unknown.

course_id.description: Numeric Studocu course ID from search-courses `course_id`. Prefer this: it pins the course and overrules `course` name/code. Omit if you only have a name/code.

institution.description: Institution display name only, e.g. "University of Amsterdam". Not an id — this tool has no `institution_id`. Infer it from the user message or conversation context when available; omit entirely if unknown. If `course_id` is also set, `course_id` wins; result institution is that course's university, not this name.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default: 10).

query.description: Topic/keywords only (e.g. "supply and demand", "microeconomics midterm 2025"). Never put course name, course id, or institution name here — use `institution`, `course`, and `course_id` instead.
